title: Tips on how to create clothing for NPCs and characters
author: MMPhotoshop
selftext:
Hello everyone.



I’ve created a city that will be inhabited by thousands of NPCs. My current challenge concerns the characters.

Here’s what I’ve done so far:

1. I’ve built a character creation system, similar to the one in \*The Sims\*, which already allows for the creation of countless characters.

2. The issue is that I also need to dress them. How do you handle clothing? Are there any plugins that can automate this process? Furthermore, I want to ensure that any clothing asset in FBX format can be adapted to fit any type of character.

3. I also need to integrate a physics/motion system (like Chaos) into the models to make them move.



How do you approach this? My goal is to minimize the manual effort required—which is why I’m using AI. Thanks a lot!

comments.author: Mother-Hedgehog-5628
comments.body: what engine? if unreal you should be using metahuman framework then GASP to make all of this easier

replies.author: MMPhotoshop
replies.body: Yes, I’m using Unreal. I’m using MetaHuman; I didn’t know about GASP—thanks a lot!
